purpose: Document first-party registry context and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review for Parakou, Benin.
assessment: ANDF is the evidenced national cadastral custodian and its official notice names Parakou among communes integrated into e-Foncier from 1 January 2025. The Mairie de Parakou separately reports municipal land-management and parceling activity. No anonymous parcel geometry, safe native ID, schema, CRS, or citywide coverage was verified.
registryAssessment: Local/national registry context verified: ANDF is the national land-and-property agency, while the official Mairie de Parakou report evidences the municipal land-management office and parceling activity. This is not evidence that parcel geometry is publicly downloadable.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Benin National Cadastre viewer. A direct curl GET with normal TLS verification failed because the certificate chain was not trusted in this environment; no certificate exception was used. The web fetch also timed out. No JavaScript/configuration, schema/CRS, or parcel response was retained.

Official ANDF notice dated 2 December 2024 explicitly lists Parakou among 12 communes integrated into the e-Foncier digital cadastral database from 1 January 2025. Administrative coverage evidence, not an open feature service.

Official ANDF site identifies the agency and advertises online cadastral services including cadastral-plan and parcel-plan extracts. No anonymous parcel geometry response was exposed in the fetched result.

Official Mairie de Parakou report says 35 zones had completed parcel application, 3 remained in progress, and the commune counted 161,934 parcels as of 23 April 2026; it also mentions strengthening the communal e-Foncier system. No downloadable parcel layer or safe ID endpoint was provided.
Official CatIS listing for ANDF's cadastral-plan extract service. It describes an e-service requiring a user request and does not expose parcel geometry or a public feature API.
